ticket.title: Migration alert should name what would migrate and where the conflict is, and must clear once applied
ticket.description:
Owner request 2026-11-06: the workbench reports 'migration needed for configs' without saying what or where. Today discover_migration (benchwork-core/src/migration/discovery.rs) only tests whether a legacy artifact EXISTS, so the banner is undismissable and uninformative.

REPRODUCED CONCRETELY: the harness root has .gaugeblock/docs.toml AND .gaugeblock/config.toml already contains the consolidated tables - so the migration has effectively been applied, yet the file was never removed and the alert still fires. Worse, the consolidated shape is nested one level too deep: config.toml carries [docs.docs.readme], [docs.docs.agents], [docs.policies] while the source docs.toml carried [docs.readme], [docs.agents], [policies]. Anything reading [docs.*] finds nothing, so the docs policy in config.toml is currently inert. That is filed separately; this ticket is the alert.

Shape: (1) for each pending item report source path, destination path, and the key-level diff - which tables or files would move and which keys already match; (2) mark an item ALREADY APPLIED when the destination already contains its content, and offer to drop the stale source; (3) surface conflicts explicitly, e.g. a key present in both with different values, naming both values; (4) make the state inspectable from the CLI ('benchwork migrate --dry-run --json') so an operator and an agent see the same thing the UI does.
